convert an IN subquery to a semi-join

reached_sql:
WITH sales_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
           ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d.d_date_sk FROM date_dim d WHERE d.d_moy = 11)
      AND ss.ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i.i_item_sk FROM item i WHERE i.i_manufact_id = 816)
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
)
SELECT dt.d_year,
       it.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       it.i_brand AS brand,
       SUM(sa.sum_sales) AS sum_agg
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN date_dim dt ON dt.d_date_sk = sa.sold_date_sk
JOIN item it ON it.i_item_sk = sa.item_sk
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
  AND it.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY dt.d_year, it.i_brand, it.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
